meta.name: understand-onboard
meta.description: Use when you need to generate an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为新成员生成项目入职指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要快速帮助新成员了解项目
copy.tagline_en: Generate onboarding guides for new team members
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to quickly help new members understand the project

howto.what: 当要求生成新成员入职指南时，Claude 会读取项目的知识图谱，提取项目元数据、架构层次、关键概念、导览步骤、文件映射和复杂度热点，然后以Markdown格式输出一份结构化的入职指南，并提供保存为文档文件的选项。
howto.when: 当用户提出为项目新成员生成入职指南的请求时触发。需要项目已有通过/understand命令生成的知识图谱文件。

say.text: 请为我们的项目生成一份新员工入职指南。
say.note: Claude 会从知识图谱生成结构化的入职文档。

say.text: 为新成员创建 onboarding guide。

howto.what_en: When asked to generate an onboarding guide, Claude reads the project's knowledge graph, extracts metadata, architecture layers, key concepts, tour steps, file map, and complexity hotspots, then outputs a structured markdown guide and offers to save it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests an onboarding guide for new team members, provided the knowledge graph file exists (requires running `/understand` first).

say_en.text: Generate an onboarding guide for our project.
say_en.note: Claude will create a structured guide from the knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Create an onboarding document for new members.
